title: Idle End-of-Row State
statement: For any natural number $l$, Boolean input word $x$, and configuration $c$ of the row controller with $l$ counter tapes and one record tape, if its state is the end-of-row state with copier control $0$, then one step of the controller leaves $c$ unchanged.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration of the row controller for $l$
replaced: Every configuration of the row controller whose control is the end-of-row state with copier control zero is left entirely unchanged by one step.
